result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the bottom navigation bar is visibly broken: the system home-indicator/gesture bar is drawn on top of the tab icons, and the tab bar appears cut off with no labels and icons clipped at the bottom edge. The rest of the page (header, search, chips, promo banner, carousels, restaurant cards) renders correctly.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar collides with the system gesture/home indicator: the dark horizontal pill is drawn directly across the Search and Orders tab icons, and the tab icons are pushed to the very bottom edge of the screen with their lower portions clipped and no labels visible. The nav bar does not respect the bottom safe-area inset.
issues.suggestion: Apply bottom safe-area inset padding to the tab bar so the icons and labels sit above the home indicator, and ensure the bar's full height is rendered within the viewport.
